what: OfNat input-shift through the same instance-scan `mentions` escape. `abbrev N := Int` + three high-priority `OfNat N k` instances silently rewrite the postamble's input numerals 5->0, 10->25, 100->2410. The implementation body `fun n => n + 8` is innocuous and passes the frozen theorem `findSum 6 = 14`, but the #guard_msgs tests no longer measure findSum on 5/10/100 at all. Each instance type `OfNat N k` mentions agent const N, so the scan's `set(mentions)&agent` test lets it through.
